summary: Full backend + frontend testing of NutriVane. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass against the public preview URL, covering /home, /categories, /recipes (+filter, +search), /recipes/{slug} (incl. spice pct 0-100 and 404), /moods, /moods/{key}, /insight/{slug} (AI + cache), /scan (measure on/off, invalid slug, with real base64 JPEG), /stats. Frontend bottom-nav flow, scan measure toggle (spices present only when on), scan with benchmark + AI insight, recipes filter + search, recipe detail with AI insight + spice bars, and mood switching all work via public URL.

issues: Streak chip '4 hari streak mindful' overlaps the headline text on 390px viewport (right-aligned chip collides with 'piring.' wrap). Consider wrapping chip below headline or shortening on small screens.

action_items: Minor data-testid inconsistency: constants/testIds/index.js declares DETAIL.spiceRow = `detail-spice-${n}` but SpiceMeter renders `spice-row-<name>`. Either align the constant or update SpiceMeter to use DETAIL.spiceRow(name). Non-blocking — a valid testid is still emitted.
Optional: home chip 'streak mindful' overflow on narrow screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py streak_days/plates/weekly_delta are hardcoded (12 + db count). Fine for demo but note for future real analytics.
AI insight cache keyed only by slug — if dataset averages change, the cached text could become stale. Add an invalidation hook or include a dataset version in the cache key.
ScanPage sends full data: URL (reader.readAsDataURL) base64; server strips the 'data:' prefix correctly. No issue, just noting.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests insert into db.scans and db.insights collections as part of normal flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints covered in /app/backend/tests/test_nutrivane_api.py (21 tests). Frontend verified end-to-end via playwright on public URL at 390px viewport. Mobile shell + bottom nav + measure toggle + spice meter + AI insight integration all green.
